# GitHub Actions Workflows

**Status:** Phase 2 placeholder

## Planned Workflows

### sync-comfyui.yml

- clone pinned or latest ComfyUI source
- run extraction scripts
- regenerate derived docs
- open a PR when references change

### build-docs.yml

- build MkDocs site
- publish generated documentation
